boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's SND_command.c, 0x0205adf8..0x0205b470: 15 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Each is identified by its body against pret's pokediamond SND_command.c: the free, reserve and waiting lists of 256 SNDCommand records, the PXI FIFO tag 7 sends, and the finished- and current-command tags.

Order: pret's file defines exactly these fifteen, its four statics last. mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse, so AllocCommand, pret's last, is lowest and SND_CommandInit, pret's first, is highest, with pret's order reversed between.

Older SDK: nothing disables interrupts around the lists and nothing spins with OS_SpinWait on a full FIFO. SND_FlushCommand has no SND_CMD_FLAG_IMMEDIATE, and there is no IsCommandAvailable: SND_AllocCommand and InitPXI give up when OS_IsRunOnEmulator is TRUE.
BOTTOM EDGE: SND_StartSeq, the highest of SND_interface.c (arm9/SND_Interface), ends at 0x0205adf8.
TOP EDGE: SNDi_CallAlarmHandler at 0x0205b470, the lowest of SND_alarm.c (arm9/SND_Alarm).
notes: Hand-assembled, following arm9/FS_Rom: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main.
All fifteen were renamed from their func_ names in this change. symbols/actor_renames.tsv records the evidence.

Text-only. The data symbols keep their address names and owners: data_020a6484 (sFreeList), data_020a6488 (sFinishedTag), data_020a648c and data_020a6490 (sReserveList and its end), data_020a6494 (sFreeListEnd), data_020a6498..data_020a64a0 (the waiting queue's read and write indexes and count), data_020a64a4 (sCurrentTag), data_020a64a8 (sWaitingCommandListQueue), data_020a64e0 (sSharedWork), data_020a6760 (sCommandArray, with the labels data_020a7760 and data_020a7f48 inside it).
